review_prompt: Confirm the Trust pathway title, authors, version, issue date and review date.
Confirm whether the November 2026 review date and local governance permit continued project use.
Supply and reconcile the cited August 2023 UK Kidney Association guidance.
Confirm mild, moderate and severe potassium bands and the fail-closed decimal-gap handling.
Confirm the ECG threshold, six listed ECG changes and mutually exclusive uncertainty choices.
Confirm the do-not-wait-for-ECG behavior at or above 7.0 mmol/L.
Define or approve the safe behavior when moderate Hyperkalaemia has no listed ECG change.
Resolve large peripheral vein versus large-bore IV access wording.
Resolve the first-15-minutes versus first-15-to-30-minutes timing wording.
Resolve duplicate page-one rows and confirm the page-two repeat-after-five-minutes workflow.
Confirm the digoxin-toxicity administration-duration branch and unable-to-determine behavior.
Confirm insulin, glucose, volume and infusion-duration wording.
Confirm the below-7.0 mmol/L follow-on glucose threshold and regimen.
Confirm standard, ischaemic-heart-disease, tachycardia and uncertain-context branches.
Resolve the page-one and page-two initiation conflict before any regimen is implemented.
Define the source's life-threatening Hyperkalaemia term or approve continued fail-closed behavior.
Supply an approved regimen or confirm that no instruction should be generated.
Confirm bicarbonate, furosemide and dialysis conditions and wording.
Confirm cardiac monitoring, outreach, senior and renal-team escalation criteria.
Confirm mild, moderate and severe potassium monitoring schedules.
Confirm the capillary blood glucose schedule after insulin/glucose treatment.
Confirm the listed causes and medication/diet recurrence-prevention actions.
Confirm clinical priority, terminology, mobile layout, accessibility and absence of visible internal references.
Record approved, changes requested or rejected; name reviewers and date the decision.
